name: Christmas Town
notes: Included with admission, park open to park close. 44 event days from Busch Gardens' official calendar (LoadCalendarData): 13-15 Nov, 19-29 Nov, 3-6 Dec, then daily 10 Dec-4 Jan; dark on 16-18 Nov, 30 Nov-2 Dec and 7-9 Dec, when the park closes 19:00. Event days open 10:00 (09:00 on 19-31 Dec) and close 20:00-22:00 (22:00 on 14, 27, 28 Nov, 5, 12 Dec and 25-30 Dec; 01:00 on 31 Dec; 19:00 on 4 Jan). New 'Lights of Wonder' show (calendar: 21:00) on 26 select nights, mostly weekends and 18-30 Dec except 24-25 Dec. Tree lighting 13 Nov 19:00; Hanukkah 4-12 Dec; Three Kings 21 Dec-4 Jan. The park.fan feed matches the official hours.

name: New Year's Eve Celebration
notes: Included; daytime Christmas Town plus a fireworks finale at night (time not published). Hours 09:00-01:00 on the official calendar and in the park.fan feed.

name: Food & Wine Music Festival
notes: Busch Gardens lists only 'February - May 2027' ('select Friday, Saturday & Sundays', with concerts); start/end are month bounds, not event dates. Included; food and drink extra. 2026 (as Food, Wine & Garden Festival) ran Fri-Sun 6 Mar-26 Apr plus Sat-Sun 2-3 and 9-10 May, 12:00 to close, park open to 21:00-22:00. BG's published 2027 hours show the same Fri 21:00 / Sat 22:00 / Sun 21:00 pattern from Fri 19 Feb to Sun 2 May, then Sat-Sun 8-9 and 15-16 May, which fits the festival weekends (2026's 16-17 May weekend was Glory in the Gardens). Concert Saturdays draw heavy local crowds.

name: Summer Nights
notes: Busch Gardens lists only 'May - August 2027' (month bounds). Included; extended hours with night shows and a drone/firework show on Fri-Sun. 2026 ran 22 May-9 Aug (daily from 29 May). BG's published 2027 hours show 20:00-22:00 closes on 22-24 May and daily from 28 May to Sun 8 Aug (23:00 on 4 Jul), consistent with a similar run.

name: Bier Fest Brews & BBQ
notes: Busch Gardens lists only 'July - September 2027', on Saturdays & Sundays (month bounds). Included; food and drink extra. 2026 ran Sat-Sun plus Labor Day, 25 Jul-7 Sep, 14:00 to close.

name: Howl-O-Scream
notes: Separately ticketed night event; Busch Gardens lists only 'September - October 2027' (month bounds, nights not published). Times are the 2026 pattern: 27 select nights Fri 11 Sep-Sat 31 Oct 2026 (Fri-Sat in Sep, Thu-Sun in Oct, nightly 27-31 Oct), 19:00 to 00:00, 01:00 on six Fri/Sat nights. On event nights the day park closed 18:00 (17:00 on most other weekdays). BG's published 2027 hours show the same 18:00 closes on Fri-Sun from 10 Sep, Thu-Sun in October and daily 26-31 Oct 2027. Intended for a mature audience. 2026 late-season sale price was $52.99. The row has no times until the 2027 nights are published: with times, every night of the two months would read as a ticketed evening.

name: Halloween Spooktacular
notes: Daytime kids' trick-or-treat event, included. Busch Gardens lists only 'September - October 2027' (month bounds). 2026 ran Sat-Sun 12 Sep-31 Oct, 12:00-16:00, with a separate Sesame Street Safari of Fun Halloween on October weekends (12:00-16:00). Does not change park hours.

name: Christmas Town
notes: 2027-28 dates not announced (the events page lists 'Christmas Town, November - January' only). Start inferred from BG's published Nov 2027 hours: 19:00 closes until Fri 12 Nov, 20:00 on Sat 13 Nov, 21:00-22:00 on Fri-Sun from 19 Nov (in 2026 event days closed 20:00-22:00, other days 19:00). End mirrors Mon 4 Jan 2027. Select nights like 2026 (44 of 53 days; dark Mon-Wed in parts of Nov and early Dec).

name: New Year's Eve Celebration
notes: Not announced. BG's published 2027 calendar already shows 09:00-01:00 for 31 Dec 2027, the same as 2026 (fireworks finale).

name: Adventure Island seasonal closure
notes: Home page: 'Adventure Island is now closed for the 2026 season and we look forward to welcoming you back in 2027.' Last 2026 day was Sun 25 Oct (fall weekends only); the official calendar shows reopening Sat 6 Mar 2027. The park.fan feed has only UNKNOWN rows for this park, so this row is the only closure signal.

name: 2027 season
notes: 199 operating days from Adventure Island's official calendar. Weekends only at the start: Sat 6-Mon 8 Mar and 13-14 Mar 2027 (10:00-17:00); daily from Fri 19 Mar to Mon 6 Sep (Labor Day); then Fri-Sun only 10 Sep-24 Oct plus Mon 11 Oct (10:30-17:00/18:00). The 2027 Fun Card terms also give 24 Oct 2027 as the last Adventure Island day. Typical hours 10:00-17:00 in spring, 09:00-18:00/19:00 in summer. Closed again from 25 Oct 2027; the 2028 reopening is not published. Far-out hours may still change.

name: AquaGlow
notes: Separately ticketed, limited-capacity neon night event. 2027 not announced. 2026 ran 22 Fri/Sat nights 22 May-8 Aug, 20:00-23:00. The 21 dates here are the Fri/Sat nights on which Adventure Island's published 2027 calendar already runs to 23:00 (28 May-7 Aug); Sat 19 Jun 2027 (to 00:00) is left out because the matching 2026 Saturday hosted Noche de San Juan instead.

name: LEGOLAND Christmas Bricktacular
notes: Included with tickets and annual passes. 26 event days listed on the official page; the park runs 10:00-19:00 on them (18:00 on 3 Jan) versus mostly 10:00-17:00 on other days (official calendar and park.fan feed agree). New LEGO Santa drone show on 5, 12 and 19-30 Dec. Tree lighting Fri 20 Nov 18:00 (not an event day). Note the theme park is closed on Wed 18 Nov, 2, 9, 16 Dec and 6, 13, 20, 27 Jan (already CLOSED rows in the feed).

name: Kids' New Year's Eve
notes: Included with tickets and select passes. Early 'midnight' countdown with fireworks before bedtime; the fireworks time is not published. Park hours 10:00-19:00 (official calendar, feed).

name: LEGO NINJAGO Weekends
notes: Included with tickets and select passes. 12 dates incl. MLK Day (18 Jan) and Presidents' Day (15 Feb); park open 10:00-18:00 on most of them (official calendar).

name: LEGOLAND Water Park seasonal closure
notes: Only the Water Park area is closed; the theme park operates. On park.fan the Water Park is part of the legoland-florida entry (its slides carry a '(Water Park)' suffix), not a park of its own, hence 'maintenance' rather than 'closure'. Official help page: 'now closed for the 2026 season ... reopens on Saturday, February 13, 2027'; an earlier version of the same page gave Sun 1 Nov 2026 as the last day. After reopening it runs weekends and Presidents' Day only (13-15, 20-21, 26-28 Feb, 11:00-16:00), then daily from Fri 5 Mar (11:00-17:00 from 6 Mar; closed Tue-Wed 6-7 and 27-28 Apr), per the official calendar. Same-day theme park + water park ticket required.

name: Red, White & BOOM
notes: Fourth of July celebration listed on LEGOLAND's seasonal events page for 4 Jul 2027, included with tickets and select passes. Hours and fireworks time not published yet (calendar ends 30 Apr 2027).

name: Brick or Treat
notes: Official page: 'Brick or Treat is Back! Fall 2027', dates TBA (LEGOLAND's 2027 guide says the same). Range mirrors 2026 on matching weekdays: 18 select dates Sat 5 Sep-Sat 31 Oct 2026 (Sat-Sun in Sep, Fri-Sun in Oct, per Haunted Attraction Network and LEGOLAND's October list); Halloween 2027 is a Sunday. Included with admission; select evenings had a drone show and later hours.

name: LEGOLAND Christmas Bricktacular
notes: Not announced. Mirrors 2026-27 (Sat 21 Nov-Sun 3 Jan) on matching weekdays: select weekend dates until mid-December, then daily through New Year.

name: Kids' New Year's Eve
notes: Not announced; annual event (early fireworks countdown, included). 2026 hours were 10:00-19:00.
